models.name: Boxio RACK Box + Bed Bundle XL/L (Kia PV5, ID. Buzz)
highlights: Modular wood rack system (Euro-box compatible) that folds into a shelf, table or bed; the supplier describes the PV5 conversion as 'within 15 minutes' and without drilling
Boxio names the Kia PV5 and the long-wheelbase VW ID. Buzz in its own blog articles
caveats: Price for the camping box and bed bundle only; vehicle bought separately. Mattress and Euro-boxes are not included

Universal system, not built for one vehicle. It counts as load and must be secured: Boxio sells lashing straps and says to strap it down unless it sits in the boot right behind the folded-up rear bench. In the PV5 the floor anchors are often missing or weak (Boxio's PV5 article); for bolting, a self-made floor plate is needed
XL bundle for the PV5 1,996 euros, L bundle for the long ID. Buzz 1,896 euros. Product pages show 'pre-order'; made to order, ship time about 4 weeks (checked 5 Nov 2026)
Weight 57.72 kg for the XL bundle and 54.75 kg for the L bundle (two bed and two box modules each); bed area not stated as a single figure. No photos in the PV5 yet, the pictures show the ID. Buzz
